title: Pricing, Channels, and Product (Updated November 10, 2026)
snippet:
## Pricing (as of November 10, 2026)
Pylon pricing = seats + agentic credits. Pylon does not charge per ticket.
| Plan | Price | Highlights |
|---|---|---|
| **Professional** | **$89 per seat/month**, annual contract | Core support, viewer seats, analytics, automations, Skills, broadcasts, MCP, API, integrations |
| **Advanced** (recommended) | **$139 per seat/month**, annual contract | Everything in Professional + RBAC, customer portal, custom reporting, data warehouse, Microsoft Teams and Google Chat channels; SAML SSO add-on |
| **Enterprise** | Custom quote | Everything in Advanced + MSA, SAML SSO, SCIM, sandbox, data retention controls, priority support SLAs |

- **Phone:** $35 per seat/month (calls, recordings, transcripts, IVR, transfers, international, number porting)
- **Account Intelligence:** $10 per customer account/month (health scores, account notebooks, CSM home view)
- **SAML SSO on Advanced:** $125/month (included in Enterprise)

**Free trial:** **Yes.** Pylon offers free trials for prospects, set up with a sales representative. Pylon does not have a free plan.

**Developer platform:** REST API, scoped API tokens, webhooks, iFrame embeds, custom apps, Pylon MCP server.

### Does Pylon have a free trial?
Yes. Pylon offers free trials for prospects, set up with a sales representative. There is no free plan.

title: Pricing | Pylon
snippet:
# Flexible pricing for every team
Your customers reach you in Slack, Teams, email and WhatsApp, and requests are coming in faster than you can hire. Pylon brings every channel into one queue and lets AI handle the busywork. You pay for the seats and AI credits your team uses, never per ticket.

Pylon is priced based on the number of seats and the number of agentic credits your team needs. Because B2B support teams vary significantly in size and workflow, pricing reflects your team's unique needs. Book a demo and we'll put together a quote specific to your setup.

Pylon's pricing is seat-based and credit usage-based. You're not charged per ticket, so your costs stay predictable as your customer base grows, even as ticket volume scales.

Does Pylon offer a free trial or free plan?

title: Pylon Pricing November 2026
snippet:
Professional — $89 / Per User Per Month
Advanced — $139 / Per User Per Month
Enterprise — Add your own price / Per User Per Month

Pylon does not offer a permanent free plan, but it does provide a free trial that lets users to test the product before committing to a paid plan. Trial availability and duration may vary, so users should review the seller's official pricing page for the most current details.

Pylon offers no permanent free tier. A free trial is available for teams evaluating Pylon's pricing before committing. The Starter plan at $59/month covers core ticketing via email, chat widget, and forms, plus a knowledge base and broadcasts, with a 3-seat minimum. Pylon's Professional tier at $89/month adds Slack Connect, CRM and API integrations, automations, SLA analytics, and developer tools — the features G2 reviewers most frequently cite as transformative. Pylon's Enterprise tier at $139/month unlocks Microsoft Teams, a customer portal, and RBAC, with a 7-seat minimum. G2 reviewers consistently identify Slack integration and automations as the primary drivers for upgrading beyond Starter.

title: pylon-mcp/README.md at main · pylonapi/pylon-mcp
snippet:
> **The Action Layer for AI Agents** — 20 capabilities, one MCP server, no API keys.
Give Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client instant access to Pylon's full API gateway. Pay per request via [x402](https://x402.org) micropayments (USDC on Base). No signup. No subscriptions.

1. Your AI agent calls a Pylon tool (e.g. `web_scrape`)
2. The MCP server routes the request to `api.pylonapi.com/do`
3. Payment is handled automatically via x402 (USDC on Base)
4. Results are returned to your agent
No API keys to manage. No billing dashboards. No rate limit negotiations. The x402 protocol handles authentication via payment — if you can pay, you can call.
